headline: test31121 Hold The Whip Hand
deck: test31121 lead test3 27-20 with a man still to play against test3's two; the paper calls it barring the absurd
body:
Twenty-seven plays twenty on the arithmetic, and test31121 hold the whip hand. Seven up with one still to play against test3's two, the trailing side needs both men to fire and the leader to freeze. That is a lot to ask of ninety minutes.

test3 keep two on the pitch and the sums keep them alive on paper. But eight-point outings are the exception, not the rule, and test3 need a version of one from a pair who have offered nothing yet. The margin is not colossal. The men to overturn it are.

Call it, then, with the small print stitched in: barring the absurd, test31121 take this one. Football has embarrassed better pundits than this desk, and two live players are two chances to be made to look foolish. The paper still calls it.
